title: BINI cements P-pop dominance with 2 top honors at Filipino Music Awards
summary: CEBU CITY, Philippines — BINI further solidified its status as one of the biggest forces in Philippine pop music after taking home Artist of the Year and Tour of the Year at the Filipino Music Awards…

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — BINI further solidified its status as one of the biggest forces in Philippine pop music after taking home Artist of the Year and Tour of the Year at the Filipino Music Awards 2026 on Tuesday, October 6.
